PRIMARY CARE NOTE   Date: 2026-05-29
40F, general wellness examination.

S:
Patient presents for her yearly wellness visit. She reports feeling generally well with good energy at work and home. No shortness of breath. She works as an office manager, mostly seated, and tries to walk during lunch. Diet includes frequent sugary drinks and takeout lunches, which was discussed. Sleep is about 7 hours most nights and appetite is good. She has no new concerns today and is interested in reviewing her preventive care. Lives with her spouse and one child. Never smoker, occasional alcohol on weekends.

O:
BP 118/74, HR 70, RR 14, Temp 98.1 F, SpO2 99% on room air. Weight 162 lb, BMI 27.
General: well appearing, in no distress.
HEENT: normal.
Neck: no lymphadenopathy, no thyromegaly.
CV: regular rate and rhythm, no murmur.
Lungs: clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Abdomen: soft, nontender, no organomegaly.
Extremities: no edema, pulses intact.
Labs (prior week): A1c 6.0%, fasting glucose 104 mg/dL, lipid panel within goal, basic metabolic panel normal.

A/P:
1. Prediabetes, counseled on diet and exercise. Reviewed reducing sugary drinks, swapping takeout for packed meals, and adding a 20-minute walk most days. Recheck A1c in 6 months and discussed a target for modest weight loss.
2. Health maintenance: cervical screening up to date; mammography discussed and scheduled given her age. Influenza vaccine offered in the fall. Reviewed the recommended immunization schedule.
3. Lifestyle: encouraged regular physical activity, balanced meals, and adequate hydration. Discussed consistent sleep and stress management around work.

Return in 6 months to review A1c, sooner as needed.
